stay.price_basis: Mid: Cleartrip detail pages, 18-19 Nov 2026, 1 room 2 adults, pre-tax discounted price of cheapest room-only rate: Ocean Blue 4050, Lemon Grass 5356, Blue Bird 4437, Sundaze 4446, De Havelock Queen 3534, The Kingdom 4006; median = (4050+4437)/2. Budget: same method, 18-19 Nov 2026, room only: Shangrilas 2184, Pano Eco 1980, Aroma 2181, Pellicon 2334; these four were in Cleartrip's 3-star list but are the cheapest cottages, used as the budget tier.
stay.notes: Dolphin Beach Resort showed 'No rooms available' for 18-19 Nov so was excluded. Placid Garden (4158) and Ile Bay (5267) cheapest rate includes breakfast so were not used. Circuit fares from Andaman Ocean's 2026 Havelock Cab Service price list (operator at Gurudwara Lane, Aberdeen Bazar, Port Blair; undated).

food_per_person_day.notes: Budget tier rests on only 2 South Indian places; one source throughout; Bonova (3000 for two, pub) excluded.

unverified: union/association cab rate card for Havelock

stay.price_basis: Mid: Cleartrip detail pages, 18-19 Nov 2026, 1 room 2 adults, pre-tax discounted price of cheapest available rate: Exotica Squares 4048 (room only), Coconhuts 4582 (room only), Moon Shine Garden 5185 (room only), Deep Sea 4830 (with breakfast), Sandy Ridge 4532 (with breakfast), CS Empire 5292 (with breakfast); median = (4582+4830)/2. Budget: same method, 18-19 Nov 2026: Amullya 2736 (breakfast), Shreesh Neil 2322 (breakfast), Purnima Residency 2890 (breakfast), Seven Seas Dream Castle 2638 (room only); median = (2638+2736)/2.
stay.notes: Three of six mid rates and three of four budget rates include breakfast (single-property rate plans, not tour packages); Neil properties mostly sell that way. Laxmi Continental showed 'No rooms available' for 18-19 Nov and was excluded; Tango Beach, Reef Valley and Neil Banjara were sold out on the 13-14 Nov list. Pearl Park (23,919 on 13-14 Nov list) is a luxury outlier and was excluded. No homestay or dorm prices found.

food_per_person_day.basis: Eternal Andamans (page updated 26 Jan 2026): Jetty Canteen 'general cost for a meal is INR 100 - INR 150'; Go2Andaman (updated 13 Apr 2026): simple fish thali at Neil Kendra market INR 100. Budget day = 3 meals x about 125 = 375.
food_per_person_day.notes: Standard left null: only wide per-person ranges (Blue Sea 500-1000, Garden View 600-1200, Dugong 800-1500) with no cost-for-two or menu figures.

stay.price_basis: Mid: Cleartrip detail page for Grand Oceanus Resort (3-star, Kodiyaghat, about 4.3 km from Chidiya Tapu per Trip.com), 18-19 Nov 2026, 1 room 2 adults, Standard Room Garden view with breakfast, 4,600 pre-tax (list 5,000, 8% off). n=1.
stay.notes: Chidiya Tapu has very few lodgings (Symphony Samudra 5-star beside the beach, Grand Oceanus at Kodiyaghat, Wild Grass Resort, Big Tree Cottages). Only one had a dated 18-19 Nov price; Symphony Samudra prints no tariff on its site and Trip.com shows only undated 'from' prices. Most visitors stay in Port Blair and day-trip (about 25-30 km).

stay.nearest_base: Port Blair (day trip); Rangat or Mayabunder for a night in the north
stay.price_basis: No priced lodging. Baratang (Nilambur jetty) has three government guest houses (Forest GH, APWD GH, Panchayat GH) listed with phone numbers and no tariff on the North & Middle Andaman district page, and one private resort (Dew Dale, NH-223) with only an undated 'from USD75' on Trip.com. Go2Andaman (updated 5 Mar 2026) says the guest houses are mainly for officials and locals, need booking months ahead from Port Blair, and that most visitors day-trip from Port Blair.
stay.notes: no_lodging means no publicly priced tourist lodging, not that no building exists. Dew Dale Resorts is the only private option found; no dated 18-19 Nov price available.

taxi_day.notes: Baratang is reached by a 100 km police-escorted convoy day trip from Port Blair; no local sightseeing rate exists on site.

food_per_person_day.basis: Only a stale single figure (AMS Restaurant about 400 for two on an old guide) was found; no menu or thali price.

stay.price_basis: Uninhabited active volcano: 'remains uninhabited by humans', landing prohibited, only day visits, no overnight stays; visit needs prior Forest Department permission in Port Blair. Outlook Traveller: 'Landing on Barren Island is prohibited' and private boats anchor offshore.
stay.notes: Trips are boat excursions from Port Blair (or live-aboard boats from Havelock); no taxi applies.

taxi_day.basis: No road or land transport exists on an uninhabited volcanic island; access is by boat only, and boats are not taxis.

food_per_person_day.basis: No food outlets on an uninhabited island.

No printed local Diglipur cab rate found; Experience Andamans' Ramnagar/Kalipur turtle tour (1,750 per person, 3,500 for 2) is a package with entry tickets and guide, so it is not used as a taxi rate.

stay.notes: Lodging exists (Hut Bay town: Sealand Tourist Home, Greenwood Island Resort, Hotel Sea Breeze, Hotel Sea Land per andamansguide.com; government APWD/Forest guest houses and an ANIFPDCL eco-resort at Butler Bay) but no page printing a rupee tariff was found. stay.price_basis: No dated or reliably priced tourist lodging. Go2Andaman (updated 6 Mar 2026): 'Only four accommodation options are available, out of which three are government-run' (Surmai Reef, Tapovan Rest House, Vanashree Forest Rest House), generally reserved for government officials and booked in advance via the Divisional Forest Officer, Rangat. The one private option, Blue Planet (about 25 guests, basic rooms), prints only an undated range 'Prices range from 300/night to 1500/night' with no currency stated, which cannot be used as a median.
stay.notes: no_lodging here means no publicly priced mainstream lodging; a few basic rooms exist. Island has no restaurants beyond Blue Planet's kitchen and a snack stall near the jetty.

taxi_day.basis: andamanislands.com: 'Getting around the island is mostly on foot' (Blue Planet Beach 700 m jungle path); boats to Lalaji Bay arranged through accommodation (Go2Andaman: about 5k per boat of 8, currency unstated). No road taxi service.
taxi_day.notes: Not applicable; ferries and boats are not taxis.

food_per_person_day.basis: No rupee food prices printed; only 'idli, vada, bhaji' near the jetty and Blue Planet's kitchen.
